auto_nix.description: Allow automatic project shell activation (devenv, flake.nix, shell.nix, default.nix), locally and in VMs. Does not grant network access.

enabled.description: Default new sessions to VM (true) or Local (false). This does not disable VM execution: each new session can override the default when a runtime is available. Existing sessions keep their mode.

idle_timeout_minutes.description: Stop idle session VMs after this many minutes; preserve their workspace and history. Zero disables idle shutdown. Open shells, active tasks and keep-warm sessions are excluded.

launcher.description: No longer read. Session VMs always start through the isolation library; remove this setting.

mode.description: How new VM sessions reach the repository. mount shares the worktree and the repository's Git directory with the guest. clone gives the guest a private clone whose only remote is a host relay limited to the session's own branch. Existing sessions keep their mode.

visible_refs.description: Extra ref prefixes advertised to a clone session, such as refs/tags/. Its base and own branch are always advertised. Ref filtering is not a confidentiality boundary: clone sessions must be trusted to read repository history.

base_branch.description: The repository's default branch for new sessions: the alternative the new-session prompt's base toggle (Alt+B) offers to the checked-out branch, and the base of sessions created without one (loom run). Unset: the toggle offers the remote's default branch, else init.defaultBranch, else main, and a session created without a base starts from the checked-out branch (HEAD's commit when detached). Each session keeps the base it was created with. Restart to apply.

worktree_dir.description: Exact worktree directory (absolute, ~/ or relative to the repository). Empty uses $XDG_DATA_HOME/loom/worktrees/<repo>-<hash>, defaulting to ~/.local/share. Existing sessions keep their paths. Restart to apply.

db.description: No longer read. The database lives in $XDG_STATE_HOME/loom/repos/<repo>/loom.db; remove this setting.

author.description: Overrides name/email for the commit author only.

committer.description: Overrides name/email for the committer only.

git.description: Session commit identity. Omit to use your normal Git identity. name/email set both roles; author/committer override one role. Values may use {model}, {modelSlug} and {profile}.

include_event_log_in_editor.description: Open the event log alongside the input on Alt+E. Defaults to false; enabling this may require :wq! in Vim/Neovim.

compat.description: Terminal compatibility mode, for mosh (e.g. from Termux): full redraws, and mouse reporting without any-motion tracking, so there is no hover underline. Clicks and the wheel still work. LOOM_TUI_COMPAT=1 turns it on too. Defaults to false. Restart the TUI to apply.

title_model.description: Model for automatic session titles; omit to use this provider’s default.

async.description: Run workspace_start alongside the agent; preparation must block.

when.description: Notification hooks: always, no focused TUI, or no connected TUI.

timeout.description: Hook timeout in seconds; clamped to 1–3600.

max_depth.description: How deep supervision may go: 1 starts no agents, 2 (the default) a supervisor and its children. Sessions at the limit get no loom-agents.

profiles.description: Named agent profiles; self (the spawner's own settings) is built in.

description.description: What the profile is for, as the agents choosing a child read it.

provider.description: Provider id, e.g. claude:personal or codex; omitted runs on the spawner's own.

model.description: Model id; omitted takes the provider's default.

effort.description: Thinking effort, for models that accept one.

mode.description: Permission mode; omitted takes the spawner's own (plan becomes manual).

mcp.description: The session MCP servers it gets, by name, plus loom-agents to let it start agents of its own. Omitted: all of them.

skills.description: Claude skills to enable, by name; omitted keeps the CLI's own.

allow.description: Built-in tools it may use; omitted allows them all.

prompt.description: Appended to the agent's own system prompt (developer instructions for Codex).

path.description: Exact repository path, absolute or starting with ~/.
